Subject: VAT handling on Redwood invoices — GreenForge Ltd.

Hi Vanessa,

Quick question from our AP team — we are getting an invoice for Redwood services (monthly hosted inference) and need confirmation on VAT treatment. Our tax team flagged that GreenForge is registered in the UK with VAT number GB123456789 and typically applies reverse-charge for cross-border B2B services. Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood will issue invoices net of UK VAT under reverse-charge, 2) what VAT ID you need from us as evidence, and 3) if you can issue a split-payment style invoice (showing net + VAT liability note) so our payment runs through our treasury system?

We can attach our VAT certificate, and we prefer payment on standard 30-day terms. Please advise so we can unblock payment.

Thanks,
Elena Martell
Finance Manager — GreenForge Ltd.

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for sending the VAT certificate. Looping in Ben (Billing Ops) and Markus (Finance) to confirm the recommended flow. High level: Redwood treats UK-registered B2B customers under the standard reverse-charge model for services supplied from our US-hosted entity when the place of supply is the UK. We can provide an invoice that states "reverse-charge — VAT liable by the recipient" and show the net amount and VAT note for your treasury.

Ben/Markus — can you confirm what evidence you need to accept reverse-charge and whether we should send an invoice CSV that maps to your ERP (you mentioned split-payment earlier). Also note GreenForge prefers a line-level representation because their AP system uses that to route gross/net to different GLs.

Vanessa Ortiz

On Sat, Jun 13, 2026 at 11:03 AM vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com wrote:
> Ben/Markus — can you confirm what evidence you need to accept reverse-charge and whether we should send an invoice CSV that maps to your ERP (you mentioned split-payment earlier).

Thanks Vanessa — Ben here. Summary and proposed path below:

1) Evidence required:
   - A copy of the customer VAT registration (we have the attached PDF from GreenForge).
   - Confirmation of business status (organisation name + registered address). Elena's email includes the company and matches VAT cert — sufficient for a first pass.

2) Invoicing approach (recommended):
   - Issue invoice from Redwood US entity showing only the net amount and a clear note: "Supply of services subject to reverse charge — customer liable for VAT in the UK (Ref: Art.194 VAT Directive)."
   - Provide a secondary CSV attachment that includes line-level mapping: product_code, description, quantity, net_amount, tax_flag (RC), GL_account suggestion. This will let GreenForge load lines into their ERP and create a liability entry on their side. I attached a draft CSV: proposed-invoice-lines.csv (sample).

3) Split-payment / Treasury routing:
   - Because you asked for split-payment visibility (net + VAT liability note), we can include an invoice stub that shows net and a separate note with the calculated VAT amount (for display only) but we will not collect VAT — the VAT cell will be labelled "not collected — reverse charge" so your AP can code it to the VAT liability ledger.

4) Payment terms and rails:
   - Standard 30 days OK. Payment should be made to our USD bank account on the invoice. If you need GBP rails, we can include our GBP receiving details (may add FX fees).

Action: Vanessa, please confirm you are OK to send the invoice net with the reverse-charge note and attach the CSV. Elena / AP, if you can confirm the ERP field names we should map (or accept our CSV), we will prepare the final invoice and send.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Billing Ops Manager — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: proposed-invoice-lines.csv

Hi Elena / AP team — thanks for the certificate and for confirming the VAT number. Ben and Markus propose the net-invoice + CSV approach which should integrate with your ERP. Two quick points:

- Could you confirm the ERP mapping for the following CSV columns (or tell us the import template): product_code, cost_center, tax_code, department. If you prefer, we can send the CSV with our suggested mappings and you can reply with field renames.
- Please confirm whether you'd like GBP beneficiary details on the invoice (we can provide GBP rails) or if you will pay USD.

If we get your ERP mapping by EOD tomorrow we can issue the June invoice today and mark it "reverse-charge — customer liable". I'll mark the invoice "display VAT cell" but flagged as not collected so your AP posts the VAT liability in your ledger.

Elena — once you confirm mapping I'll issue and attach the invoice PDF (net only) + CSV. Thanks — appreciate the rapid turnaround here.

Best,
